semantics: Operands evaluated once left-to-right; original operator return value and dispatch preserved.
All observed type pairs at a site must qualify globally; unsafe producer contexts reject the entire site because they may change shared state.

Whole-patch eligibility requires exact single equal-width Is/Eq text replacement with every other character unchanged; IsNot/NotEq is algebra-only and rejected for whole patches to avoid unrelated same-line code position changes.
Code acquisition audits record qualname/firstline and recursively all nested code constants. Collection acquisition retains all tests only for affected code objects.
Source readers retain file precision. Cached code objects acquired before hook and direct co_code/co_consts access remain an audit coverage gap.
Preexisting target modules are explicit and permanently ineligible even if later reloaded.
limitations: No unconditional skip authorization; certificates are conditional operand algebra observations.
Untracked subprocesses, missing context receipts, unknown/failed/skipped executions preclude global completeness.
Two full trace attempts were intentionally interrupted and remain globally incomplete; process-pool and Python -c subprocess capture is integrated and passed a combined smoke test.
Fixed deterministic warm-suite trajectory induction does not establish cold/reordered or nondeterministic execution equivalence.
Instrumentation changes stack, globals, timing and reference lifetimes; reflection coverage remains empirical.
